summary.goal: Allow users to create a new plan by expressing a goal in natural language
summary.context: Intent-first planning: user types what they want to achieve, AI identifies affected scopes, drafts multi-scope plan with steps, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. User refines and adds gates.

acceptance_criteria.description: Text input accepts goal description (1-500 chars)
AI processes goal and identifies affected scopes
AI generates draft plan with steps grouped by scope
AI adds acceptance criteria to steps
Loading state shows while AI processes
Generated plan opens in editor for refinement

acceptance_criteria.description: API client module created for REST endpoints

steps.title: Create NewPlanPage component
steps.description: Create page component with goal input textarea, context optional field, and create button.

acceptance_criteria.description: Page renders with prominent goal input

steps.title: Implement plan creation API call

acceptance_criteria.description: Click calls POST /plans with goal and context

acceptance_criteria.description: Loading state shows AI is working
